visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a grey t-shirt and a watch carries a young girl with her hair tied in buns on her back. The girl, in a floral printed dress, is soundly asleep with her head on the woman's shoulder. They are outdoors in what looks like a theme park with green foliage and other visitors blurred in the background. The lighting is bright and natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to the woman holding the child in front of her, facing the camera. The woman is speaking and smiling broadly, her facial expressions showing amusement and high energy. The child remains asleep, eyes tightly shut, with her head drooping. They are in a crowded area with stone pavements and various people walking by. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom and top of the frame. (3) The camera focuses on the child's face as the woman tries to wake her. The woman holds a handful of white popcorn in her palm. The child starts to eat a piece of popcorn while still appearing very sleepy, eyes barely opening. The background shows a large metal gate and park structures. The woman's hands are visible as she carefully feeds the child. (4) The child is now more awake but still looks drowsy, chewing slowly on the popcorn. The woman laughs and looks at the camera, then back at the child. They are surrounded by a crowd of people in a bustling theme park environment. The child holds her arms around the woman's neck. The camera captures her sleepy blinks and chewing motions in a medium close-up shot. (5) The video ends with a flat animation graphic on a solid pink background. It depicts a cartoon girl sitting down with a peach icon on her arm. The text POPO'S DAILY LIFE is displayed in white capital letters below the illustration. The lighting in this phase is flat and graphic-based with no real-world depth.
